title: Constraint Scope Restriction
statement: Let $D$ be a domain, let $V$ be a finite set of variables, and let a constraint have an ordered scope of pairwise distinct variables. For any assignment $a:V\to D$, the first component of its decomposition into values on the scope and values off the scope, at position $i$ in the constraint's scope, is $a$ evaluated at the variable occupying position $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A CSP template and a constraint from that template on $V$ are given
The index $i$ belongs to the constraint's arity
